# Vendored Sparks Notation Runtime

This directory contains the `packages/core` and `packages/util` source snapshot from Sparks Notation commit `e3b1e92`, licensed under Apache-2.0.

The snapshot includes local renderer changes for dynamic measure density, beat-scoped spacing, curved tuplet marks, SVG barlines, and JPW-ABC teaching output. Modified files retain the upstream history in the source project and are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at the repository root.
